Thanks for the review!

The result will still be correct. However, doing that means a copy always occurs during the `.flat()` call, even when children doesn't contain `Array.isArray(c)`. Since I want to avoid copying when it doesn't contain it, I'd like to keep the current implementation as-is for that part.

It's a difficult point, but I think that `.at(-1)` is better for this PR, because I think that `.at(-1)` is currently used in the following parts of hono.
* Where simplicity is prioritised
* Where short code is prioritised

I think that `.length - 1` is better if it is code that is called for each request, such as a router.
@usualoma Thank you for the comment. I agree. Let's go with `.at(-1)` in this PR!

```ts
if (this.#isFresh && !headers && !arg && this.#status === 200) {}
```
